_doc: The 8 mm slot of the 30 mm series as European sellers stock it ("B-type", made to match Bosch Rexroth's), for unbranded stock: the figures one named seller's CAD outline gives (KJN), agreeing with a second seller's drawing where that prints one (Dold Mechatronik). Far-East "3030" stock is close to it: 8.2 between the lips, 16.5 under them and 9.2 deep (Systeal's and Spool3D's drawings). The 40 mm series' 8 mm slot is a different, deeper one: slot-8-i. Every figure is community: measure the bar you have. The drawn slot leaves out the small step at the mouth and the V groove in the floor.
name: slot-8

opening.rule: Between the lips: 8 in KJN's outline, "8,0 + 0,3 mm" at Dold. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
opening.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN990720 (30x30), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/8mm%20Slot/30X30_KJN990720.dxf

lip_thickness.rule: From the face to the lip's underside, in KJN's outline (Dold dimensions none). Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
lip_thickness.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN990720 (30x30), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/8mm%20Slot/30X30_KJN990720.dxf

cavity_width.rule: Width under the lips, in KJN's outline. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
cavity_width.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN990720 (30x30), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/8mm%20Slot/30X30_KJN990720.dxf

cavity_depth.rule: From the face to the floor: KJN's outline and Dold's drawing agree. Unbranded stock differs from seller to seller: measure yours
cavity_depth.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN990720 (30x30), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/8mm%20Slot/30X30_KJN990720.dxf

floor_width.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN990720 (30x30), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/8mm%20Slot/30X30_KJN990720.dxf

flank_angle.rule: The flanks close in at 45 degrees, in KJN's outline
flank_angle.source: KJN Aluminium Profile, DXF of part KJN990720 (30x30), https://www.aluminium-profile.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/downloadfiles/DXF_Files/ALUMINIUM%20PROFILE/8mm%20Slot/30X30_KJN990720.dxf

nut_family.rule: Sold with "slot 8 B-type" nuts; not the I-type nuts of the 40 mm series
